## History

In her early life, Emily worked as a schoolteacher and accumulated money of her own. After marrying Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she separated from him and returned to her own house following arguments over housecleaning habits and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). ## Quotes

> "I want to get acquainted with all my new neighbors just as soon as possible. Mrs. Lynde is a lovely woman, isn’t she? So friendly."
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P61](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0061)

> "Well, I did think this place seemed too tidy . . . much too tidy for James A. to be living here, unless he has greatly changed since I knew him"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012)

> "A friend sent a marked copy to me . . . friends are always so ready to do such things. James A.‘s name was written in over ‘new citizen.’"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P14](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0014)

> "because he happens to be married already. I am his wife. Oh, you may well look surprised. I suppose he has been masquerading as a bachelor and breaking hearts right and left. Well, well, James A.,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

> "your fun is over. I am here . . . though I wouldn’t have bothered coming if I hadn’t thought you were up to some mischief. I suppose"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Harrison](../character/harrison.md) is Emily's husband. The two were originally separated due to disagreements over housecleaning habits and Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Emily eventually returns to him, leading to their reconciliation, with [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) admitting he is glad to have her back.

- Spouse of — married (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), +1 more</sub>

### [James A](../character/james-a.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--james-a.md)

[James A](../character/james-a.md) is Emily's husband. After a past separation, Emily unexpectedly arrives at his house to reunite with him. Despite their history apart, the news of her arrival spreads quickly through the neighborhood as they resume their marriage.

- Spouse of — married husband and wife (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065)</sub>

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--lynde.md)

[Lynde](../character/lynde.md) is a friend of Emily. The two struck up a friendship after going shopping for wallpaper together in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).

- Friend of — went shopping for wallpaper in Carmody together and struck up a friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a close, lifelong friend of Emily. [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) takes a keen interest in Emily's life, investigating the situation when Emily unexpectedly returns to reunite with her husband.

- Friend of — struck up a lifelong friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) is Emily's distant relative, specifically her father's second cousin. Emily operates a boardinghouse at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) stays during the summer and writes about the quirky guests residing there.

- Relative of — father's second cousin (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>
